tickets.count.where: Ticket marks on the Draw keys, the ticket cards and the sealed card: how many of that kind are left, printed after the mark

tickets.summary.dailyAndReserve.where: Screen-reader name of a Draw key (sticker board, refilled out-of-tickets card, ticket shop after a purchase): joins the two ticket counts

tickets.summary.daily_one.where: Screen-reader name of a Draw key: the daily ticket count, when one is left

tickets.summary.daily_other.where: Screen-reader name of a Draw key: the daily ticket count

tickets.summary.reserve_one.where: Screen-reader name of a Draw key: the reserve ticket count, when one is left

tickets.summary.reserve_other.where: Screen-reader name of a Draw key: the reserve ticket count

tickets.refillIn.underAMinute.where: Out-of-tickets card: the countdown after the refill time, in the last minute before new daily tickets arrive

tickets.refillIn.hoursAndMinutes.where: Out-of-tickets card: the countdown after the refill time, such as "in 6h 56m"

tickets.refillIn.hours.where: Out-of-tickets card: the countdown after the refill time, on the hour, such as "in 6h"

tickets.refillIn.minutes.where: Out-of-tickets card: the countdown after the refill time, in the last hour, such as "in 42m"

tickets.reserve.where: Start card and out-of-tickets card: the small label beside the reserve ticket count, under the daily ticket stubs

tickets.draw.where: The Draw key on the out-of-tickets card once the refill brings tickets back, and on the ticket shop's card after a purchase

tickets.drawWithTickets.where: Screen-reader name of that Draw key (refilled out-of-tickets card, ticket shop after a purchase); `tickets` is both counts in words

tickets.shopForTickets.where: Start card when only reserve tickets are left, and the out-of-tickets card: the button under the key that opens the ticket shop

tickets.goToStickerBoard.where: Out-of-tickets card (the main key, or the button under Draw once refilled) and the card shown while tickets load: goes back to the sticker board

tickets.notNow.where: Quiet link at the foot of the start card, the tickets-didn't-load card and the ticket shop's card: closes the card without spending or buying

tickets.tryAgain.where: Key on the card when tickets didn't load, and the link after the ticket shop's balance or price problem: tries again

tickets.startDrawing.daily.title.where: Start card on the drawing screen, before a fresh sheet, while daily tickets are left: the title asking to spend one
tickets.startDrawing.daily.title.ja: チケットを使ってかきますか？

tickets.startDrawing.daily.left_one.where: Start card, daily ticket variant: the bold line under the title, when one daily ticket is left

tickets.startDrawing.daily.left_other.where: Start card, daily ticket variant: the bold line under the title saying how many daily tickets are left
tickets.startDrawing.daily.left_other.ja: 無償チケットは残り{{count}}枚です。

tickets.startDrawing.daily.timer.where: Start card, daily ticket variant: the quiet line after the count, about the drawing timer
tickets.startDrawing.daily.timer.ja: 最初のひと筆で{{minutes}}分のタイマーが始まります。

tickets.startDrawing.daily.start.where: Start card, daily ticket variant: the key that spends a daily ticket and opens the sheet

tickets.startDrawing.reserve.title.where: Start card on the drawing screen once today's daily tickets are used: the title asking before a reserve ticket is spent
tickets.startDrawing.reserve.title.ja: 有償チケットを使いますか？

tickets.startDrawing.reserve.left_one.where: Start card, reserve ticket variant: the bold line under the title, when one reserve ticket is left

tickets.startDrawing.reserve.left_other.where: Start card, reserve ticket variant: the bold line under the title saying the daily tickets are gone and how many reserve tickets are left
tickets.startDrawing.reserve.left_other.ja: 今日の無償チケットは使い切りました。有償チケットは{{count}}枚あります。

tickets.startDrawing.reserve.refillAt.where: Start card, reserve ticket variant: the quiet line after the count, saying when new daily tickets arrive (midnight in Tokyo, in the person's own time)
tickets.startDrawing.reserve.refillAt.ja: {{time}}に新しい無償チケットが届きます。

tickets.startDrawing.reserve.use.where: Start card, reserve ticket variant: the grape key that spends a reserve ticket and opens the sheet

tickets.outOfTickets.title.where: Out-of-tickets card on the drawing screen, when both daily and reserve tickets are used up: the title
tickets.outOfTickets.title.ja: 今日はもうチケットがありません

tickets.outOfTickets.refillLine.where: Out-of-tickets card: the line under the title, when new daily tickets arrive (bold) and the countdown to it (quiet)
tickets.outOfTickets.refillLine.ja: {{time}}に新しい無償チケットが届きます（{{countdown}}）

tickets.outOfTickets.refilled.where: Out-of-tickets card: the title once the refill brings tickets back while it's open, as the card turns over
tickets.outOfTickets.refilled.ja: 新しいチケットが届きました

tickets.notLoaded.checking.where: Drawing screen, in the start card's place: the title while your tickets load
tickets.notLoaded.checking.ja: チケットを確認しています…

tickets.notLoaded.couldntLoad.where: Drawing screen, in the start card's place: the title when your tickets didn't load, above the reason
tickets.notLoaded.couldntLoad.ja: チケットを読み込めませんでした

tickets.shop.title.where: Ticket shop, as a card over the drawing screen or as the Shop tab: the title

tickets.shop.lead.where: Ticket shop: the bold line under the title
tickets.shop.lead.ja: 有償チケットに有効期限はありません。

tickets.shop.balance.where: Ticket shop: the small label on the wallet row, beside the balance shown in yen

tickets.shop.readingBalance.where: Ticket shop: the wallet row while the balance loads
tickets.shop.readingBalance.ja: 残高を確認しています…

tickets.shop.balanceProblem.where: Ticket shop: the wallet row when the balance couldn't be read, before a Try again link; `reason` is the wallet's own words
tickets.shop.balanceProblem.ja: 残高を確認できませんでした（{{reason}}）。

tickets.shop.gettingPrices.where: Ticket shop: in the packs' place while today's prices load
tickets.shop.gettingPrices.ja: 今日の価格を確認しています…

tickets.shop.pricesProblem.where: Ticket shop: in the packs' place when today's prices couldn't be fetched, before a Try again link
tickets.shop.pricesProblem.ja: 今日の価格を確認できませんでした：{{reason}}

tickets.shop.packs.where: Ticket shop: screen-reader name of the group of pack buttons

tickets.shop.pack_one.where: Ticket shop: a pack button's name, for the one-ticket pack

tickets.shop.pack_other.where: Ticket shop: a pack button's name, such as "3 tickets"

tickets.shop.discount.where: Ticket shop: the pink sale sticker on a discounted pack button

tickets.shop.was.where: Ticket shop: screen-reader text for a discounted pack's struck-through full price

tickets.shop.pay.where: Ticket shop: the grape pay key, before a pack's price is known

tickets.shop.payPrice.where: Ticket shop: the grape pay key, with the chosen pack's price

tickets.shop.paying.where: Ticket shop: the pay key while the payment goes through

tickets.shop.notEnoughYen.where: Ticket shop: the pay key, disabled, when the balance is less than the chosen pack's price

tickets.shop.added_one.where: Ticket shop after a purchase: the title, when one reserve ticket was added

tickets.shop.added_other.where: Ticket shop after a purchase: the title saying how many reserve tickets were added
tickets.shop.added_other.ja: 有償チケットを{{count}}枚追加しました

tickets.shop.paid.where: Ticket shop after a purchase: the quiet line under the title with the price paid

tickets.shop.buyMore.where: Ticket shop after a purchase: the button under Draw that goes back to the packs
tickets.shop.buyMore.ja: チケットをもっと買う

tickets.shop.paymentFailed.where: Ticket shop when a payment fails: the title, above the reason
tickets.shop.paymentFailed.ja: 支払いが完了しませんでした

tickets.shop.paidButNotAdded.where: Ticket shop when a payment fails after the money moved: the line under the title; `digest` is the transaction's ID, `reason` the error
tickets.shop.paidButNotAdded.ja: 支払いは完了しました（{{digest}}）が、チケットは追加されませんでした：{{reason}}

tickets.shop.backToShop.where: Ticket shop when a payment fails: the key that goes back to the packs
